bio: Set on a rise overlooking the village, Hotel Bergblick not only boasts charming guestrooms and attractive spa facilities but also offers a culinary experience well worth discovering. With just five tables, this small restaurant exudes tasteful elegance, with gentle piano music drifting in from the reception area. Diners are treated to a refined seven-course tasting menu that is rooted in classic culinary tradition yet infused with modern flair. Service is friendly and professional. Austrian labels dominate the well-curated wine list. Pairings by the glass are available to go with the set menu. Tip: Given the limited capacity, it's essential to book. An impressive collection of clocks is on display, as is a stylish 1912 French vintage car – complete with MICHELIN tyres!...
